title: Require Domain Ops Binding Surface
forbids: domain root ops.ts files missing the canonical domain and implementation imports or default createDomain binding, or containing any additional statement
why: Root domain ops.ts is the closed executable binding owner. It binds the public domain contract to its implementation registry without also becoming a helper barrel, policy owner, convenience API, or second runtime authority.
remediate: Keep only the canonical createDomain, domain, and implementations imports plus the default createDomain(domain, implementations) binding. Move every helper, policy value, schema, operation body, and convenience export to its owning surface.
message: Domain root ops.ts must contain only the canonical order-independent createDomain binding surface.
